title: End-of-Support for the Client Certificate Posture Type for All Android Devices

blocks.text: Beginning with Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 for Android, Zscaler is ending support for the Client Certificate posture type on all Android devices.
This announcement supersedes the previous announcement published on August 9, 2023, which ended support for the Client Certificate posture type on Samsung Android devices only.

If your organization currently uses the Client Certificate posture type for Android devices, update your Private Access access policies to remove these checks before users install or upgrade to Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 or later for Android and Android on ChromeOS.
Failing to update these policies may result in Private Access access issues for Android users.
